title: Deep Research Eighth Full Reset — Tournament Finalists (2026-08-02)
method: 12-round elimination tournament scoring 60 candidate ideas under zero-dollar startup and immediate revenue constraints.

items.name: FactBounty — Buyer-Funded Product Proof Exchange
items.reason: Tournament winner. Fastest to revenue, zero pre-funding required, compounds into reusable product-evidence graph.

items.name: Product Evidence API for Shopping Agents
items.reason: Highest structural upside; acts as B2B monetization layer for FactBounty evidence data.

items.name: MeasureGraph — Exact Dimensions Evidence Network
items.reason: Lowest liability risk, highly deterministic measurements, immediate appeal for physical goods buyers.

items.name: Compatibility Bounties
items.reason: High bounty values for hardware/part compatibility; requires clear safety disclosures.

items.name: Verified Owner Answers — Cross-Retailer Q&A
items.reason: Broad customer appeal; competes with free Q&A forums.

items.name: Revision & Variant Proof Registry
items.reason: Resilient long-term data asset for component changes across revisions.

items.name: Local Shelf Proof — Real-Time Retail Stock Evidence
items.reason: Strong demand from shopping agents; cold-start local responder network challenge.

items.name: Seller ProofLink — Guided Listing Verification
items.reason: Complements FactBounty on seller side; crowded trust-badge market.

items.name: Real-World Noise & Clearance Facts
items.reason: Best deployed as specialized request category inside FactBounty rather than standalone.

items.name: Receipt-Verified Purchase Data Exchange
items.reason: High privacy compliance burden; low individual consumer willingness-to-pay.
